weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on foe during combat, and also, the following effects will occur based on the value of total bonuses on unit + value of total penalties on foe: if ≥ 5, "foe cannot make a follow-up attack"; and if ≥ 10, "unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack"; and if ≥ 15, "inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat." (Example: if unit has an Atk/Res+6 bonus and foe has an Atk/Res-6 penalty, the calculated total will be 24.)

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+7 during combat.

b.d: At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Def-3 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Def-5 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Def-7 on that foe through its next action.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, if unit is within 4 spaces of a foe, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on nearest foes through their next actions and grants Atk/Res+6 to unit for 1 turn.
